help.title: Jonckheere-Terpstra Test
help.body:
Description
Non-parametric test for a monotonic trend across three or more ordered independent groups (e.g., increasing dose levels). This is different from Kruskal-Wallis, which only tests whether groups differ, not whether they differ in a specific ordered direction.

Requirements
• Grouping variable must have 3 or more levels.
• The levels must represent a meaningful order (e.g., control < low < medium < high, or increasing numeric doses). Choose how BioStat Prime should order the levels using "Group Level Ordering" below.

R function used: DescTools::JonckheereTerpstraTest()
R Packages required: DescTools
